import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
p=base+'/task-67307b44.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Separator color divides the grid into rectangular regions; classify by count of 2s.
    sep = 9 if any(9 in row for row in grid) else 3
    row_bands=[]
    start=0
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v==sep for v in row):
            if start<i: row_bands.append((start,i))
            start=i+1
    if start<len(grid): row_bands.append((start,len(grid)))
    col_bands=[]
    start=0
    for j in range(len(grid[0])):
        if all(row[j]==sep for row in grid):
            if start<j: col_bands.append((start,j))
            start=j+1
    if start<len(grid[0]): col_bands.append((start,len(grid[0])))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[i][j]==2 for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1)) >= 2 else 5
             for c0,c1 in col_bands] for r0,r1 in row_bands]
'''
